backends.name: GL4ES Android ARM64
backends.notes: GL4ES 1.1.7 built for Android ARM64 with NDK r27. MIT licensed. Exposes OpenGL 2.1 only — compatible with Minecraft 1.16.5 and older. Bundled with the launcher.

backends.name: MobileGlues Android ARM64
backends.notes: MobileGlues 2.0.0 — Desktop GL on top of GLES 3.x. Supports Sodium and Iris shaders. LGPL-2.1 licensed, not redistributable — download from the official MobileGlues releases and import the ZIP manually. Backend pack created from MobileGlues_2.0.0.apk (lib/arm64-v8a/libmobileglues.so, 6,120,864 B).

backends.name: Zink (Mesa) Android ARM64
backends.notes: Desktop OpenGL over Vulkan via Mesa's Zink driver. Requires Vulkan 1.2+ and a compatible GPU driver. No verified Android ARM64 build available — not directly installable. Import manually if you have a compatible package.

backends.name: Krypton Wrapper Android ARM64
backends.notes: Modernised GL4ES fork for newer Minecraft builds (1.13-1.20). LGPL-3.0 licensed, not redistributable. No verified Android ARM64 build available — download from official releases and import manually.

backends.name: LTW (ANGLE) Android ARM64
backends.notes: Proprietary ANGLE-based wrapper. Cannot be redistributed. No authorized Android ARM64 package available — user must supply libltw.so and related files. Import via Settings → Renderer → Import backend pack.

backends.name: System GLES (device driver)
backends.notes: Uses the device GLES driver directly with no translation layer. Diagnostic only — Minecraft's desktop GL calls are not generally available through a plain GLES context.
